title: Ghouls in Waves
summary: The ghouls come in waves: knocking from where nothing lives. Nial Lathom wants the first wave broken and then the second, with a word between them.
offer_text: "It is not one pack, it is two nights of them, knocking from where nothing lives. Break the first and come and tell me. Then we finish it."
turn_in_text: "That is two waves broken. I will not say it is over, but I will say it is quiet."

objectives.text: Tell Nial Lathom the first are down
Kill 2 more ghouls at the edge
Tell Nial Lathom the edge is clear

relationship.label: Held the line against the ghouls
